definitions.explanation: The circumstances of one's growth from childhood, including family environment, education, and experiences that shaped who one is today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Knowing about an author's background can deepen your understanding of their works.

notes:
{生|お}い{立|た}ち refers to the narrative of how someone grew up — their family environment, upbringing, and experiences from childhood through adolescence.

ETYMOLOGY:
Noun form of the verb {生|お}い{立|た}つ (to grow up).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to tell about one's upbringing
- {生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to hear about someone's background
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{生|お}い{立|た}ち: complicated background
- ⟦{恵|めぐ}まれた→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧{生|お}い{立|た}ち: privileged upbringing
- {生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記|き}: record of one's upbringing (often read at weddings)

USAGE:
Common in biographical contexts, interviews, and wedding ceremonies. At Japanese weddings, the {生|お}い{立|た}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ (introduction of the couple's backgrounds) is a standard part of the program.
